help.short: The name of the Data Lake Analytics account.

The maximum degree of parallelism per job this user can use to submit jobs. This property, the min priority per job property, or both must be passed.

description: Create the specified compute policy. During update, the compute policy with the specified name will be replaced with this new compute policy. An account supports, at most, 50 policies
